name: Switch
description: Instant on/off toggle, built on Base UI. Token-only.

checked.description: Controlled checked state. Use with onCheckedChange for a controlled switch.

defaultChecked.description: Initial checked state for an uncontrolled switch.

onCheckedChange.description: Called when the switch is toggled.

disabled.description: Ignores user interaction and dims the control.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only. Do not restyle color or thickness.

forbidden: Do not use Switch for a choice needing a submit action — pair with an explicit save action if the effect is not instant.
Do not use Switch for more than two mutually exclusive options — use ToggleGroup or Select instead.
Do not restyle color or track/thumb size via className.
Do not omit an adjacent visible label — Switch has no built-in label.

responsive.note: Pair Switch with a tappable label row (e.g. inside a list item) so the effective touch target reaches 44px, since the track itself is smaller.
